notes.title: 1000 Players - Update V1.1.0!
notes.notes:
Nova Core Chaos reached +1.000 players and the first update milestone has been reached! Thank you very much for downloading and playing our game! 

[h1]WHAT'S NEW?[/h1]
Difficulty customizability has been added to the game! What does this mean? From now on, you can adjust the settings when you're in the game but ONLY BEFORE everyone has readied! 

[h2]Amount of lives[/h2]
Want to be able to get less failed orders in a run? Or would you like to be able to extend your run with more lives? You'll be able to choose between 1 to 5 lives, depending on what kind of run you want! 

[h2]Customer timer[/h2]
Are the customers not patient enough for you? Fear not! This will also be customizable in the settings screen. The lower the number, the less patient they'll be!

[h2]Move Speed[/h2]
Want to add extra chaos to the game? Tweak with the movement speed! Doesn't matter if the speed increases or decreases, chaos will happen! 

[h1]HOW TO ACCESS?[/h1]
Make sure that you have the latest update and you will find the menu in the pause screen! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799973/05858427714180257798c5b3239f97ca26df2e0c.png[/img]

notes.title: THANK YOU FOR 500 PLAYERS!
notes.notes:
Our team is proud to share that Nova Core Chaos reached 500 unique downloads in its first week after release! Reaching this milestone means a lot to us and we are incredibly grateful for the support our game has received so far. We have been looking into the feedback we have gotten on our game so far and have decided to provide some cool free updates and extra content when we reach more milestones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799973/88a1abe2e91fcc52d0128ef30ecb91c09eceffe7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] 1000 DOWNLOADS: Difficulty customizability!
We will make it possible to change the difficulty settings to improve individual players’ experiences.

[*] 2500 DOWNLOADS: Hats!
You’ll be able to customize your Novas with cute hats, which you can earn by creating more and more Novas!

[*] 5000 DOWNLOADS: New Map!
An entirely new map with new challenges will be added to the game for an even more chaotic experience!

[*] 10 000 DOWNLOADS: Leaderboard (& even MORE hats)!
Upon reaching this milestone, a leaderboard will be added to the game so people can compete with each others’ scores or beat their own high score!

[*] ?
[/list]
We hope to be able to reach even more milestones and improve Nova Core Chaos even more in the future.

Make sure to share the word about Nova Core Chaos so we can reach these milestones and put out more amazing content for you guys. Thank you all for the support!
